transmissions.title: TX-C01  FIRST LIGHT
body: RECEIVED ON THE SECOND LINE. NOT FROM THE SKY.
IF YOU ARE READING THIS, THE PANEL IS OPEN.
SOMEBODY WROTE THIS, ON PURPOSE, AND SOMEBODY ELSE CHECKED IT.

archives.title: IS ANYONE ELSE ON THIS LINE
body: This board isn't in the index. I don't know how long it's been here.
Keel's note says to leave a message. So: hello. I found the panel. The list of who has been here is short, and it is signed.
